narrative_alignment_note: Published winner's own OOS-Sharpe-by-lead curve (foreground, PHLX Semiconductor Index) on the DAILY axis; deployed lead 63d = 1.57. Grey bars: best-of-any-signal envelope on the same daily grid. Buy-and-hold SPY = 0.82. On the pair's OWN daily grid the winner's own curve peaks at its deployed 63d lead — a genuine ~63-trading-day lead, not a same-day co-move. Grey bars are the best any signal reaches at each lead (envelope ≥ winner curve by construction); read the shorter-lead values to see whether the edge decays or reverses ahead of the deployed lead.
